listing.tagline: Hold a key and speak: start a session or send a prompt with no Enter press
listing.description: Hold Ctrl+Shift+Space, speak and let go. "New session, fix the flaky test" opens the New session dialog with that prompt, and anything else goes to the session on screen as a prompt and is submitted. Kanban's New session microphone uses the same speech to text. Hex does the speech to text on your machine.

screenshots.alt: Kanban's New session dialog opened by voice while the user still speaks: the Prompt field shows "Fix the flaky login test and then run the" and a Listening pill sits at the bottom of the hub window
screenshots.title: Words show up as you speak
screenshots.caption: "New session" opens the dialog at once, and the rest of what you say fills the Prompt field.

screenshots.alt: The Hex website: "Speak. It appears.", local voice dictation for Windows, with the Windows installer and a PowerShell install command
screenshots.title: Hex does the speech to text
screenshots.caption: Install Hex and start it once. It runs on your machine, and the hub sends it the sound while you hold the keys.
